name: The Taste of Freedom
source:
The Taste of Freedom is a whimsical yet bittersweet visual novel featuring three humanized food characters, each longing for “escape.” 

Meet Milk Chocolate, an innocent and cheerful chocolate trapped in a mysterious dungeon.

Meet Sour Cream & Onion Chip, a “top student” living under high expectations and academic pressure.

Finally, meet Raspberry Scone, an absent-minded and unpredictable scone living with difficult parents.

The player's choices will determine whether they crumble under despair, or finally—taste freedom.

[From [url=https://asterisksrn.itch.io/the-taste-of-freedom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《自由的滋味》是一部奇思妙想又苦乐参半的视觉小说，围绕三名渴望“逃离”的拟人化食物角色展开。

你将结识“牛奶巧克力”——一块被困在神秘地牢之中、天真烂漫又开朗乐观的巧克力；

结识“酸奶油洋葱薯片”——一名背负着沉重期许与巨大升学压力的“优等生”；

最后结识“覆盆子司康饼”——一块与难缠父母同住、整日心不在焉又捉摸不透的司康饼。

玩家的选择将决定他们最终是在绝望中彻底碎裂，还是终于——品尝到自由的滋味。

[摘自[url=https://asterisksrn.itch.io/the-taste-of-freedom]itch.io[/url]]
